title: Mossy Cobblestone to Moss Stone
description: Changes Mossy Cobblestone's name to 'Moss Stone', as it was before 1.13
body:
Changes Mossy Cobblestone's name to 'Moss Stone', as it was before 1.13. Fairly self-explanatory.

The name change applies to Moss Stone Bricks as well, for consistency.

Enjoy!
